anthropometric_data.population: Healthy adult males 20-40 y (Drillis & Contini 1966); stature fixed by project to 1.80 m
anthropometric_data.description: Segment-length and joint-height ratios from Drillis & Contini (1966); canonical base stature 1.80 m

metadata.notes: Ratios are population means; individual variance is large (see OPEN Design Lab, PSU). Widths/depths other than shoulder breadth and hip width remain ASSUMPTION. Weight/age/gender remain ASSUMPTION.

height.name: total_body_height
height.notes: Canonical base stature chosen by the project (design decision 2026-09-29, DECISION_LOG). Not a population statistic.

head_height_ratio.name: head_height_to_total_height (vertex to chin)
head_height_ratio.notes: Drillis & Contini (1966) via Winter (2009) Fig. 4.1; healthy adult males 20-40 y; no formal landmark definitions in the source
